result_text:
The region overview's open-ticket list now sorts high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within each priority. It matches the sales-rep list.

The change is one `ORDER BY` in `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, plus its Javadoc. The filters are unchanged, so closed tickets and other regions are still excluded.

`RegionManagerTest` and `DemoScenarioTest` pass offline. Neither test has more than one open ticket per region, so neither checks the new order. I didn't add a regression test for the T-1..T-5 example; say if you want one. Nothing is committed.
